environment: Chromium on Windows; local static HTTP host; WASM one thread

retrieval_demonstration.note: Eight author-chosen synthetic paraphrases, not an independent or general accuracy benchmark. Exact displayed cosine scores rounded to3decimals.

cases.query: a dangerous voyage guided into port
a meal shared with an absent sibling
a craftsman saves a timepiece to remember his father
returning to a stage many years after a first performance
moving away from home to start a new life
hearing someone speak through wireless static
repairing a jacket with a needle to help a coworker

offline_after_fresh_load.procedure: Clear only app caches/registration; fresh page and model load; disable browser network; reload page; initialize model again; search.
offline_after_fresh_load.query: a voyage brought safely into harbour

ambiguous_query.observation: The anticipated waiting letter was third. The top match is not a verified interpretation of the query.

network.scope: Tested initialization, search and local import; no claim about the static host’s own logs.

limitations: Timing is rounded from UI output and device-specific. Offline cache depends on browser support/storage availability. No cross-browser or independent retrieval benchmark was performed.
